name: Barbell Pause Squat
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back, unrack it cleanly, and step into a balanced shoulder-width stance with toes angled slightly out.
Brace your core, bend your hips and knees together, and descend under control until your thighs drop below parallel.
Hold completely still at the bottom while keeping your trunk braced and your legs under active tension.
Drive powerfully through your midfoot without bouncing to stand tall back to the starting position.
tips: Stay tight throughout the pause rather than relaxing onto your joints at the bottom.
Keep your chest proud and knees tracking over your toes as you drive out of the pause.
